# Temple Scroll Column 10 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** 11QT (Cave 11), Col. 10 | **Condition:** Fragmentary; Festival calendar concludes

---

**10:1** [...] on the fifth [day], Gad and Asher [...]

**10:2** [...] on the sixth [day], Dan and Naphtali [...]

**10:3** [...] this is the day of the wood offering [...]

**10:4** [...] a permanent law for all your generations [...]

**10:5** [...] wherever you live, in the presence of the LORD [...]

**10:6** [...] they will praise the LORD their God [...]

**10:7** [...] who gave them the land as their home [...]

**10:8** [...] after these days [...] the special day of remembrance [...]

**10:9** [...] the first day of the seventh month [...]

**10:10** [...] a day of remembrance marked by trumpet blasts [...] a sacred assembly [...]

**10:11** [...] present a burnt offering [...] a food offering, a fragrant aroma for the LORD [...]

**10:12** [...] one young bull [...] one ram [...] seven one-year-old male lambs [...]

---

*PNEUMA notes: Column 10 wraps up the wood offering and pivots to the autumn festivals. The praise for God's gift of the land (lines 6-7) provides a theological frame. The Memorial of Trumpet Blasts (lines 8-12) opens the seventh-month festivals, corresponding to what later tradition calls Rosh Hashanah. "Day of remembrance marked by trumpet blasts" expands the terse Hebrew for clarity.*
